book.title: Cookbook
book.tagline: Recipes worth keeping, written so the prep is done before anything goes in a hot pan.

search.title: Search
search.noResultsHint: Try one ingredient, like “eggs” or “boerenkool”. Both languages work.
search.empty: Type a dish, an ingredient or a tag. English and Dutch both work.

recipe.prepIntro: Chop, measure and preheat, and set everything within reach. Cooking starts when this list is done.
recipe.clearTicksQuestion: Clear all ticks for this recipe?
recipe.clearTicksExplain: Every ticked ingredient and prep task is unticked, here and on the shopping list, so you can start over. Your servings stay.
recipe.clearDrinkTicksExplain: Every ticked ingredient is unticked, here and on the shopping list. Your number of drinks stays.
recipe.screenOn: Your screen stays on while you cook
recipe.sharedServings_one: Set to {{count}} person by a shared link. Your shopping list follows.
recipe.sharedServings_other: Set to {{count}} people by a shared link. Your shopping list follows.
recipe.sharedDrinks_one: Set to {{count}} drink by a shared link. Your shopping list follows.
recipe.sharedDrinks_other: Set to {{count}} drinks by a shared link. Your shopping list follows.

drink.madeTodayOffList: Made today. Cheers! It’s off the shopping list.
drink.clearedTicks: The ticks are cleared for the next round.

prep.locked: Tick off every prep task to start cooking.
prep.ready: Everything is ready. Time to cook.

cook.prepNotDoneExplain: This recipe works best when everything is ready before you start cooking.
cook.notFinishedExplain: Finish the last cooking step to get here.
cook.finishedTodayExplain: To cook it again, start with the prep.

done.title: Enjoy your meal
done.body: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks and timers are cleared, ready for next time.
done.bodyOffList: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks and timers are cleared and it’s off the shopping list, ready for next time.
done.bodyTimersLeft_one: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks are cleared. Its timer keeps going, so you’ll still hear when it’s time.
done.bodyTimersLeft_other: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks are cleared. Its {{count}} timers keep going, so you’ll still hear when it’s time.
done.bodyOffListTimersLeft_one: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks are cleared and it’s off the shopping list. Its timer keeps going, so you’ll still hear when it’s time.
done.bodyOffListTimersLeft_other: That’s {{title}} done. The ticks are cleared and it’s off the shopping list. Its {{count}} timers keep going, so you’ll still hear when it’s time.
done.backOnList: Put it back on the shopping list

timer.soundOff: Tap anywhere to turn on the alarm sound

notFound.title: This page isn’t in the book
notFound.body: The recipe may have moved to another chapter, or the link has a typo.

shopping.title: Shopping list
shopping.emptyHint: Add recipes from their page, then shop for all of them at once.
shopping.clearExplain: All recipes are taken off the list. What you ticked stays ticked on the recipes.

sync.title: Sync between phones
sync.intro: Keep favourites, the shopping list and what you cooked the same on every phone. No account needed: phones that know the same four words share one book.
sync.unsafe: Anyone with the four words can see and change what is shared. Fine for a shopping list, not for secrets.
sync.haveWordsHint: Scan the code on that phone with this phone’s camera, or type its four words here.
sync.linkQuestion: Connect this phone to the shared cookbook?
sync.linkExplain: Favourites, the shopping list and what you cooked on this phone are added to it. Nothing here is lost.
sync.scanHint: Open the camera on the other phone and point it at this code.
sync.codeLabel: Code to scan with another phone
sync.wordsHint: Write them down, on the fridge for instance. On a new phone they bring everything back.
sync.leaveExplain: Everything stays on this phone, and the other phones keep syncing. To join again you need the four words.

status.offline: No connection: your changes wait until there is one.
status.serverError: Can’t reach the cookbook server right now. Your changes wait.
status.spaceNotFound: These words no longer work. Stop syncing and start again.

failure.unknownWords: These words aren’t on the list: {{words}}. Check the spelling.
failure.spaceNotFound: No cookbook uses these words. Check them against the other phone.
failure.offline: No connection. Try again when this phone is online.
failure.serverError: Something went wrong on the server. Try again in a moment.
